title: Recursive Self-Improvement in AI: From Bounded Self-Refinement to Autonomous Research Loops
abstract: arXiv:2607.07663v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI systems increasingly participate in their own improvement: revising their outputs, adapting their harnesses during deployment, training on data they generate, and conducting AI research itself. This literature uses a vocabulary ("self-refine," "self-reward," "self-play," "self-evolve") that conflates fundamentally different ambitions. We survey 1,250 arXiv papers (2024-2026) along two axes: what the system improves -- its behavior in deployment, its policy through training, its evaluator, or the research process itself -- and the degree of loop closure (human-in-the-loop to fully closed). The taxonomy separates bounded self-refinement -- convergent, evaluable, and industrial practice -- from open-ended recursive self-improvement (RSI), which remains bounded by grounding requirements, collapse dynamics, and compute constraints on every measured axis. translated_title: AI中的递归自我改进：从有界自我精炼到自主研究循环
translated_abstract: AI系统正日益参与到自身的改进之中：修订自身输出、在部署期间调整其运行框架、用自己生成的数据进行训练，以及开展AI研究本身。这一领域的文献使用了一套词汇（“自我精炼”、"self-reward"自我奖励、"self-play"自我博弈、"self-evolve"自我演化），而这些词汇混淆了根本不同的目标。我们沿两个维度对1,250篇arXiv论文（2024-2026）进行了综述：系统改进的对象是什么——其在部署中的行为、通过训练获得的策略、其评估器，还是研究过程本身——以及循环闭合的程度（从人在回路到完全闭合）。该分类法将有界自我精炼——收敛的、可评估的、已成为工业实践——与开放式递归自我改进（RSI）区分开来，后者在所有测量维度上仍受制于接地要求、崩溃动力学和计算约束。其独特之处在于为自我评估设立了专门的类别：每一次改进……
tldr: 该论文对1,250篇arXiv文献进行系统综述，沿“改进对象”与“循环闭合程度”两个维度构建分类法，将已成熟的有界自我精炼与仍受接地要求、崩溃动力学和计算约束所限的开放式递归自我改进（RSI）清晰区分开来。
en_tdlr: This survey of 1,250 arXiv papers introduces a taxonomy along two axes—what the system improves and the degree of loop closure—distinguishing mature bounded self-refinement from open-ended recursive self-improvement (RSI), which remains constrained by grounding requirements, collapse dynamics, and compute limits.
